scenes.text: She lived alone and kept a tidy fridge.
scenes.art_prompt: a lonely lighthouse on a black cliff at night, beam sweeping the sea, heavy fog, ominous

scenes.text: On Monday there was a note on the milk: you forgot the eggs.
scenes.art_prompt: an open handwritten logbook on a wooden desk, single oil lamp, long shadows

scenes.text: She had forgotten the eggs. She laughed it off.
scenes.art_prompt: an empty coastal village at dusk, no people, curtains moving, unsettling calm

scenes.text: On Friday the note said: you are reading this on Friday.
scenes.art_prompt: a staircase descending into darkness, faint light below, damp stone walls

scenes.text: It was the only note she had not written herself.
scenes.art_prompt: a reflection in a dark window that does not match the room, horror

scenes.text: Follow for more Quiet Horror Files.
scenes.art_prompt: a lighthouse gone dark at the edge of a storm, waves heavy, final dread
